text: Harbour City’s tactical shift to press higher and play more directly increased their possession from 31.7% to 40.8%, showing a positive adjustment in response to trailing 2-3 late in the match [#1884]. However, despite this reactive change—raising press from 0.6 to 0.78 and line height from 0.62 to 0.74—they still failed to generate shots or clear chances, indicating that the increased aggression did not translate into offensive opportunities immediately [#1884]. Seabrook Town maintained control and field tilt with their wide crossing style, so Harbour City’s approach improved ball recovery but lacked penetration. For future coaching, focus on integrating the increased directness and higher press earlier to create more sustained pressure and clear chances, rather than as a last-minute reactive tactic.
